# [PR #19575] [None][fix] Python transceiver: run gen-side KV transfer consensus across helix CP ranks under attention-DP

## 正文

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Dev Engineer Review
Generation-side consensus now requires matching completed request IDs across CP ranks and, when present, PP ranks in attention-DP. Non-DP consensus remains world-wide. Attention-DP without CP or PP retains its no-sync path. `KVCacheManagerV2` now accepts attention-DP with helix; the remaining Helix restrictions still reject block reuse and draft managers.

The DeepSeek V3 Lite helix integration path now uses the Python transceiver with NIXL. This changes the backend and runtime used by that test path.

## QA Engineer Review
The modified unit test file adds coverage for PP-only consensus, cancellation retirement after all CP ranks drain, and V2 manager construction with attention-DP and helix CP. Existing tests cover CP and CP-plus-PP agreement, attention-DP without CP or PP, and non-DP world all-gather. The manager test is parameterized for MHA and MLA.

The integration test configuration and helper changes affect DeepSeek V3 Lite and shared helix-test execution. The B200 CI list includes DeepSeek V3 Lite and Qwen3-8B helix selectors, marked `TIMEOUT (60)`. The supplied search does not establish whether those selectors appear in manual-QA lists. The waiver removal re-enables the B300 DeepSeek V3 Lite `test_auto_dtype_with_helix` case. The author reports passing the listed unit and integration tests; these results are not independently established here. Coverage verdict: needs follow-up.

## Per-File QA Perspective
- `tensorrt_llm/_torch/disaggregation/transceiver.py`: Verify consensus participants and completed-request agreement across CP and PP ranks. Check that non-DP and attention-DP-without-CP-or-PP behavior remains unchanged.
- `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/kv_cache/kv_cache_manager_v2.py`: Verify V2 manager initialization accepts attention-DP with helix and still rejects the other restricted Helix configurations.
- `tests/unittest/disaggregated/test_transceiver_adp_helix_consensus.py`: Covers CP, PP-only, combined CP-plus-PP, cancellation retirement, no-sync attention-DP, and non-DP consensus. No corresponding integration test-list entry was identified.
- `tests/unittest/disaggregated/test_cache_transceiver_single_process.py`: Covers V2 manager construction with attention-DP and helix CP for MHA and MLA. No corresponding integration test-list entry was identified.
- `tests/integration/defs/accuracy/test_disaggregated_serving.py`: Changes the shared helix helper and DeepSeek V3 Lite configuration to Python transceiver with NIXL. The relevant DeepSeek V3 Lite and Qwen3-8B helix selectors appear in the B200 CI list with `TIMEOUT (60)`; manual-QA listing is not established.
- `tests/integration/defs/disaggregated/test_configs/disagg_config_ctxtp2_gentp1cp2_deepseek_v3_lite_bf16_tllm_gen.yaml`: Changes both workers to NIXL with the Python runtime. Verify this configuration in the helix disaggregated-serving path.
- `tests/integration/test_lists/waives.txt`: Removes the waiver for the B300 DeepSeek V3 Lite helix test. Verify that the re-enabled test passes.

## Description

Under attention-DP the Python KV cache transceiver (`KvCacheTransceiverV2`) skipped the gen-side transfer-completion consensus entirely when `pp_size == 1`, assuming every DP rank owns disjoint requests. With helix context parallelism the CP ranks of one DP group share the same requests, so a CP rank could start decoding a request whose KV blocks its partner rank had not received yet, and the helix all-to-all deadlocked (all gen ranks stuck in `cuda_event.synchronize()`, killed by the hang detector after 300 s).

`KVCacheManagerV2` rejected attention-DP + helix for exactly this reason (`disagg transfer-completion consensus is skipped under attention-DP`); that is what fails `TestDeepSeekV3Lite::test_auto_dtype_with_helix[...pp1dp2cp2...]` once the test is moved to the Python transceiver (see #19472). Switching the test to the V1 manager only turns the ValueError into the hang.

This PR mirrors the C++ transceiver, which builds its attention-DP sync group from all PP x CP ranks of the same DP index (`mGroupDataComm`):

- `transceiver.py::_init_sync_policy`: under attention-DP, gather over the CP group (then PP when present) and require `pp_size * cp_size` agreements. Non-DP and DP-without-CP paths are unchanged.
- `kv_cache_manager_v2.py`: lift the attention-DP + helix rejection.

Verified on 8xB300 with DeepSeek-V3-Lite disaggregated serving (ctx tp4 -> gen tp2 cp2 helix, attention-DP on, Python transceiver / NIXL, GSM8K ref 64.74 / threshold 61.54):

| Config | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| KV manager V1, overlap on | hang (300 s hang detector) | 64.14 |
| KV manager V2, overlap on | ValueError at startup (hang if rejection removed) | 63.38 |
| KV manager V2, overlap off | ValueError at startup | 64.33 |
| non-DP `pp1tp2cp2`, overlap on (regression check) | 64.94 | 64.94 |

## Test Coverage

- New `tests/unittest/disaggregated/test_transceiver_adp_helix_consensus.py`: sync policy and consensus under attention-DP with CP, CP x PP, and the unchanged DP-without-CP / non-DP paths.
- Existing transceiver unit tests (`test_transceiver_bounded_polling.py`, `test_sync_transfer_timing.py`, `test_transfer_ownership_regressions.py`, `test_kv_cache_transceiver_contract.py`): 149 passed against the patched package.
- Integration: `accuracy/test_disaggregated_serving.py::TestDeepSeekV3Lite::test_auto_dtype_with_helix[fifo_v2-cudagraph:with_padding-pp1dp2cp2-overlap_{on,off}]` on the Python transceiver (migrated in #19472).
